findings.claim: matching evaluates one field state at each chunk centre
external rigid displacement is linearly interpolated in time with endpoint hold
the drifty matcher enables continuous spatial interpolation whenever motion is active
continuous template interpolation targets geom minus the unrounded displacement
integer pitch selection rounds displacement divided by probe pitch
the separate templates_at_time path uses integer pitch shifts for static-channel selection

conclusion: Both actual runs used the drifty continuous spatial interpolation path. D2L evaluated the unrounded external field at 7500-sample chunk centres; integer pitch support remained a separate path.
